about_the_game:
In the winter of 210 AD, the renowned genius strategist Zhōu Yú died of a sudden illness. Qiáo Qīng, his widowed concubine, reminisces on their bittersweet relationship while going through the belongs in their bedroom.

You, the player, will act on Qiáo Qīng's behalf. Your choices will affect her sentiment, which in turn will affect how the game ends. 

If you are a history lover and a Three Kingdoms fan, this short game is a perfect treat for you!

Key Highlights

  • Visual novel: a plot-centric story where your choices matter

  • Hidden plotlines and endings unlocked after multiple playthroughs: different combinations and ordering of choices will lead to different outcomes. Some memories can only be unlocked over multiple playthroughs

  • Rich historical foundation with unlockable research: many details in the plot are based on Three Kingdoms Records and other historical scripts, and references are documented in a detailed research section for you to collect

  • Musical minigame: immerse yourself more in Qiáo Qīng's life by practicing music on her behalf

  • Bilingual: fully bilingual plot in English and Chinese (can be set in Settings)
